title: What if unlocking your phone at night triggered a flashbang warning?

lines.text: One thirty A M. You tap your phone in the dark. Bad idea.
caps: You tap your phone in the dark.

lines.text: A cyan reticle locks onto your face. Tactical flashbang in three. Two. One.
caps: A cyan reticle locks onto your face.

lines.text: You panic. Max brightness. Auto dim is offline. The buttons do nothing.
caps: Max brightness. Auto dim is offline.

lines.text: Then the screen detonates. A hundred percent of brightness, straight into your eyeballs.
The whole bedroom goes stadium bright. Dust everywhere. The frame is shaking.
caps: The whole bedroom goes stadium bright.

lines.text: Silence. Smoke off your head. Retina damage: ninety nine percent.
Recovery time: six hours. You are legally blind until sunrise.
caps: You are legally blind until sunrise.

lines.text: So naturally, you reach up and tap the screen one more time.
caps: you reach up and tap the screen

lines.text: Checking notifications. Round two is already charging up.
caps: Round two is already charging up.
